description: KP astrology (Krishnamurti Paddhati) chart: the star lord, sub-lord and sub-sub-lord of every planet and house cusp, cuspal sub-lords and the A/B/C/D house significators. Krishnamurti Paddhati on the KP ayanamsa with Placidus cusps: for each of the 9 grahas and 12 cusps the sign lord, star (nakshatra) lord, sub-lord, sub-sub-lord and number among the 249 KP subs; the cuspal sub-lords; house significators at the four levels A (in the star of occupants), B (occupants), C (in the star of the lord), D (lord); and each planet's significations. The sub-division rule is stated in the response. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.15 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/vedic/kp (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

datetime.description: Local birth date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

options.description: Optional KP settings. Cusps are always Placidus (the KP convention).

node_type.description: Rahu/Ketu from the mean or the true (osculating) lunar node.

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

name: kp_chart

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

cusps.description: The twelve Placidus cusps: longitude, sign and sign lord, nakshatra, star lord, sub-lord (the cuspal sub-lord), sub-sub-lord and KP sub number.

planets.description: The nine grahas: sidereal longitude, sign and sign lord, nakshatra, star lord, sub-lord, sub-sub-lord, KP sub number (1-249) and its span, Placidus house and retrograde flag.

settings.description: Settings applied: KP system, sidereal zodiac, ayanamsa (name and value), Placidus cusps, node type, and the exact sub-division, house and significator rules.

significators.description: 'houses': for each house the A, B, C and D significators and all of them in order of strength; 'planets': the houses each graha signifies, level by level.

subject.description: The resolved input: 'time' (local input, time zone and historical UTC offset, UT, Julian days, Delta T) and, when given, 'location' (latitude, longitude).

warnings.description: Notes on the input or the calculation (for example an assumed noon for an unknown birth time). Present only when there is something to say.

title: KP chart (Krishnamurti Paddhati)
